name: trickshot
description: Trick Shot — precision chain-hoop arcade on Celo

scripts.build: npm run build -w @trickshot/shared && npm run build -w @trickshot/physics && npm run build -w @trickshot/logic && npm run build -w @trickshot/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @trickshot/shared && npm run build -w @trickshot/physics && npm run build -w @trickshot/logic && npm run build -w @trickshot/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @trickshot/shared && npm run build -w @trickshot/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @trickshot/shared && npm run typecheck -w @trickshot/physics && npm run typecheck -w @trickshot/logic && npm run typecheck -w @trickshot/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @trickshot/shared && npm run build -w @trickshot/physics && npm run build -w @trickshot/logic && npm run test -w @trickshot/shared --if-present && npm run test -w @trickshot/physics --if-present && npm run test -w @trickshot/logic --if-present && npm run test -w @trickshot/web --if-present
scripts.build:edge: npm run build -w @trickshot/shared && npm run build -w @trickshot/physics && npm run build -w @trickshot/logic
scripts.test:edge: npm run build:edge && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.edge.json node --import tsx --test 'supabase/functions/_shared/*.test.ts' 'supabase/functions/auth-magic/*.test.ts' 'supabase/functions/runs-start/*.test.ts' 'supabase/functions/runs-finish/*.test.ts' 'supabase/functions/leaderboard/*.test.ts' 'supabase/functions/catalog/*.test.ts' 'supabase/functions/purchase-intent/*.test.ts' 'supabase/functions/purchase-confirm/*.test.ts' 'supabase/functions/inventory-use/*.test.ts' 'supabase/functions/challenge-progress/*.test.ts' 'supabase/functions/continue-intent/*.test.ts' 'supabase/functions/continue-confirm/*.test.ts'
